# Question

What has to be decided, in one paragraph, and what is blocked until it is.

## Options

Each one with what it buys and what it costs. Not a list of possibilities — a
list of trade-offs, so the decision can be made from this page.

## Statistics

Whatever can be measured about the choice: how many places it touches, how much
of the code each option changes, what already exists that one option reuses.

## Recommendation

One of them, with the reason. A question with no recommendation is a question
asked twice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The decision recorded here, and in `docs/decisions.md` if reversing it
      would break something not obvious at the point of reversal.
- [ ] Whatever the decision implies for the code or the documents, done.
